# wisp-science v1.22.0 — Routes and Scopes

**Each connection and Skill now has its own route or scope.** You can set a network route for each model API, subscription and MCP connection. Skills show where they are installed and which copy is in use, and each project has its own set of shared-browser tabs. Windows installers are now code-signed.

## Network routes per connection

- **Settings → Network** still sets the default route for each kind of traffic. A model API address, a subscription or a custom MCP connection can now pick its own route instead: **Inherit Network settings** (default), **Direct**, or a **Custom proxy** (HTTP, HTTPS or SOCKS5).
- **Model APIs**: set the route in the model edit form or in **Add API access**. All models on the same API address share the route, including image and video generation and the decision model when it uses that address.
- **Subscriptions** (ChatGPT, ChatGPT Codex, SuperGrok): each card saves its own route for sign-in, token refresh and model requests.
- **MCP**: each custom connection stores its own proxy for its HTTP and OAuth requests, or passes it to its local process. The MCP form now shows add and update errors instead of failing silently. See [network settings](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.22.0/docs/network-settings.md).

## Skill install scope

- **Add skill** asks whether to install for **All projects (global)** or **This project only**. It shows the path it will use and warns that a project Skill is removed together with the project folder. After installing, it tells you the scope, the path, and whether another copy with the same name takes precedence.
- The Skill list shows how many copies of each Skill exist. The detail page marks the **Active** and **Shadowed** copies and identical duplicates.
- **Promote to global** copies a project Skill to `~/.wisp/skills` and never overwrites an existing one. **Remove project copy** appears only when a global or identical copy will keep the Skill available.
- When you delete a project together with its local data, the confirmation lists the Skills in its `.wisp/skills` folder and suggests promoting them first. See [Skills](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.22.0/docs/skills.md).

## Shared browser per project

- Each project only sees and controls the tabs it opened, popups from those tabs, and tabs you shared with it from the approval prompt. Other projects' tabs are hidden and refused.
- A project's tabs stay in one window, grouped as **Wisp · <project>**. If you close that window, the next tab opens in a new one. Tabs you drag to another window leave the project. Restarting the browser clears the project's remembered tabs.
- Window pinning and tab groups need browser extension 0.5.0. Older extensions still keep projects apart but do not pin windows.

## Conversations and notifications

- Desktop notifications and sounds are now silenced only for the conversation you are looking at. Previously they were dropped whenever any Wisp window had focus, so a conversation finishing in another project's window or behind another conversation was never announced.
- In watch-only subagent conversations, the brief from the parent agent or research assistant appears under a sender card instead of looking like a message you typed.

## Reliability

- On macOS 12, **Settings → Models → Add provider** no longer stays on "Saving settings…" forever. Arguments from the Models panel are sent as plain JSON, saves time out after 60 seconds, and a reply that cannot be read closes the form, reloads the model list and shows a toast.
- `wisp.log` now records the first renderer panic or WebAssembly trap and the first rejected command argument in each window, to help diagnose packaged builds. Values from the arguments are never logged. See [webview recovery](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.22.0/docs/webview-recovery.md).

## Website

- The homepage hero plays an entrance animation and a live research conversation demo in Chinese and English, with previews of tables, code, figures and equations. Reduced motion shows the finished conversations.

## Downloads

- **macOS**: signed and notarized DMGs for Apple Silicon and Intel, with in-app updates for compatible installations. Separate SwiftUI DMGs and checksums are also published.
- **Windows**: MSI / NSIS installers and the separate WinUI 3 preview installers are now signed with an SSL.com certificate. SmartScreen may still warn until the certificate builds reputation.
- **Linux**: deb and AppImage packages for x86_64 and aarch64.
- **Mobile**: the signed [Android APK](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/releases/download/v1.22.0/wisp-science_1.22.0_android.apk) installs over the previous version. Install iOS through Xcode.
- **Relay image**: `ghcr.io/xuzhougeng/wisp-relay:1.22.0` and `:latest` for amd64 and arm64.

Desktop assets appear as the platform workflows finish.

[All changes since v1.21.0](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/compare/v1.21.0...v1.22.0)

# wisp-science v1.22.0 — 路由与作用域

**每个连接和技能现在都有自己的路由或作用域。** 每个模型 API、订阅和 MCP 连接都可以单独设置网络路由。技能会显示装在哪里、哪一份在生效。共享浏览器的标签页按项目分开。Windows 安装包现在带代码签名。

## 按连接设置网络路由

- **设置 → 网络**仍然为各类流量设置默认路由。现在模型 API 地址、订阅和自定义 MCP 连接可以各自选择路由：**继承网络设置**（默认）、**直连**或**自定义代理**（HTTP、HTTPS 或 SOCKS5）。
- **模型 API**：在模型编辑表单或**添加 API 接入**中设置。同一 API 地址下的所有模型共用这条路由，包括图像、视频生成，以及使用同一地址的决策模型。
- **订阅**（ChatGPT、ChatGPT Codex、SuperGrok）：每张卡片单独保存路由，用于登录、刷新令牌和模型请求。
- **MCP**：每个自定义连接单独保存代理，用于它的 HTTP 和 OAuth 请求，或传给它的本地进程。MCP 表单添加或更新失败时会显示错误，不再静默失败。详见[网络设置](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.22.0/docs/network-settings.md)。

## 技能安装范围

- **添加技能**时可以选择**所有项目（全局）**或**仅当前项目**。界面会显示安装路径，并提醒项目技能会随项目文件夹一起删除。安装完成后会告诉你作用域、路径，以及是否有同名的其他副本优先生效。
- 技能列表显示每个技能有几份副本；详情页标出**当前生效**和**已遮蔽**的副本以及内容相同的重复副本。
- **提升为全局**会把项目技能复制到 `~/.wisp/skills`，不会覆盖已有的同名技能。只有在全局副本或相同副本能保证这个技能继续可用时，才会出现**删除项目副本**。
- 删除项目及其本地数据时，确认框会列出 `.wisp/skills` 中的项目技能，并建议先把它们提升为全局。详见[技能](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.22.0/docs/skills.md)。

## 共享浏览器按项目隔离

- 每个项目只能看到和控制自己打开的标签页、这些标签页弹出的窗口，以及你在审批提示中共享给它的标签页。其他项目的标签页会被隐藏，访问也会被拒绝。
- 一个项目的标签页固定在同一个窗口里，并归入名为 **Wisp · <项目>** 的标签组。关掉这个窗口后，下一个标签页会在新窗口里打开。你拖到其他窗口的标签页会离开该项目。重启浏览器后，项目记住的标签页会被清空。
- 固定窗口和标签组需要 0.5.0 版浏览器扩展。旧版扩展仍会隔离各项目，但不会固定窗口。

## 对话与通知

- 现在只有你正在查看的那条对话才不弹通知、不响提示音。以前只要任意一个 Wisp 窗口在前台，所有通知都会被丢弃，所以另一个项目窗口里、或被其他对话挡住的对话完成时不会提醒。
- 在只读的子代理对话里，父 Agent 或研究助理发来的任务说明显示在发送者卡片下，不再看起来像你自己输入的消息。

## 稳定性

- 在 macOS 12 上，**设置 → 模型 → 添加服务商**不再一直停在「正在保存设置…」。模型面板的调用参数改为普通 JSON 发送，保存 60 秒后超时；回复无法解析时会关闭表单、重新加载模型列表并弹出提示。
- 为便于排查安装版的问题，`wisp.log` 现在会记录每个窗口的第一次渲染端 panic 或 WebAssembly trap，以及第一次被拒绝的命令参数。参数里的值不会写入日志。详见 [WebView 恢复](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.22.0/docs/webview-recovery.md)。

## 网站

- 首页主视觉新增入场动画，以及中英文的实时研究对话演示，可以预览表格、代码、图和公式。开启「减少动态效果」时直接显示完成后的对话。

## 下载

- **macOS**：Apple Silicon 与 Intel 的签名、公证 DMG，兼容安装支持应用内更新；另提供 SwiftUI 版 DMG 和校验文件。
- **Windows**：MSI / NSIS 安装包和独立的 WinUI 3 预览安装包现在使用 SSL.com 证书签名。证书积累信誉之前，SmartScreen 仍可能提示警告。
- **Linux**：x86_64 与 aarch64 的 deb、AppImage 安装包。
- **移动端**：[签名 Android APK](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/releases/download/v1.22.0/wisp-science_1.22.0_android.apk) 可直接覆盖安装旧版本；iOS 通过 Xcode 安装。
- **中继镜像**：`ghcr.io/xuzhougeng/wisp-relay:1.22.0` 与 `:latest`，支持 amd64、arm64。

各平台流水线完成后，桌面安装包会陆续出现在附件中。
